scripts.test:e2e: set -euo pipefail; trap 'if [ -n "${API_PID:-}" ]; then kill "$API_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi' EXIT; pnpm run build; pnpm --filter @chirp/api run db:seed; pnpm --filter @chirp/api run start > /tmp/chirp-api.log 2>&1 & API_PID=$!; until curl -sf http://localhost:3001/health > /dev/null 2>&1; do if ! kill -0 "$API_PID" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'API server exited before becoming healthy' >&2; cat /tmp/chirp-api.log >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; pnpm --filter @chirp/client-user exec playwright test --workers=1; pnpm --filter @chirp/client-admin exec playwright test --workers=1
scripts.ci:local: pnpm install -w --frozen-lockfile && pnpm -w turbo run lint --since=origin/master && pnpm -w turbo run typecheck --since=origin/master && pnpm -w turbo run test:unit --since=origin/master && pnpm -w turbo run build --since=origin/master
